text: The decision journal is one file per decision, for D-0096: `decisions/journal/D-0097.jsonl` holds every write to D-0097, one line each, chained by hash. D-0096 had one file per repository, but two open pull requests that each record a decision would both add a line at its end, which git calls a conflict, as `decisions/log.md` saw three times on 2026-09-28. With a file per decision, parallel pull requests touch different files. @gitdek chose it while slice 12 was being built.
